articles.summary: The Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) has warned parents to avoid using unofficial 'SAMAGAM' applications. Officials state these apps are fraudulent and pose a high risk of personal data misuse.
articles.explain: KVS is the governing body for a network of schools across India. This advisory is a digital security warning, urging users to only interact with official government portals to avoid 'phishing'—a technique where hackers create fake apps to trick people into providing passwords or personal details.

story.title: KVS Digital Security Warning
story.so_far: Kendriya Vidyalayas are a system of central government schools in India. Like many state institutions, they are increasingly digitizing communication with parents, which has created opportunities for cybercriminals to create phishing apps aimed at harvesting sensitive user data.

articles.source: India Latest News: Top National Headline
articles.summary: Parents of a deceased IIT Bombay student have filed a petition demanding a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the death. They argue the local police investigation lacks the necessary rigor.
articles.explain: The CBI is India's premier federal investigative agency, generally reserved for complex or high-profile cases. By asking for a 'CBI probe' and 'court-monitored' investigation, the family is effectively asking for the case to be taken away from local police, whom they do not trust to be impartial or thorough.

story.title: IIT Bombay Student Death Investigation
story.so_far: IIT Bombay is one of India's most prestigious technical institutes. Incidents involving the well-being and death of students often draw massive public attention, sparking debates about academic pressure, mental health support, and the responsiveness of campus and civil authorities.

articles.source: India Latest News: Top National Headline

articles.explain: The FDA is a regulatory agency that oversees food safety and compliance. 'Adjudication' here refers to a legal or quasi-legal process where an authority hears evidence and decides if a violation of law occurred. Surrogate advertising is a common tactic used to bypass bans on tobacco or alcohol advertising by using the brand name on a permissible product, like an 'elaichi' (cardamom) brand.

A 'code of conduct' is a set of rules meant to ensure fair play, requiring candidates to focus on professional goals rather than engaging in personal attacks or dirty campaign tactics.

story.title: BJP Organizational Strategy
